note: Seven evals. Fixture directories under files/ are copied into the run's working directory as the project root before the prompt is given. Assertion wording follows SKILL.md rule 2: the human prose (H1 title text, section bodies) follows the log's language, while the adr-tools scaffolding (the `Date:` label, the four `## Status/Context/Decision/Consequences` headings, the status word, and the supersede/amend verbs) stays canonical English so Structurizr's `!adrs` importer and `adr generate` keep parsing.

evals.name: clear-decision-fresh-repo
evals.prompt: No nosso serviço de pedidos a gente decidiu usar PostgreSQL em vez de MongoDB. O motivo principal é que o fluxo de criação de pedido atualiza estoque, pagamento e pedido juntos e precisa de transação ACID; além disso o time já tem experiência com Postgres e a empresa já paga RDS. A desvantagem que discutimos é que o schema fica mais rígido e migrações viram um passo de deploy. Escreve um ADR documentando essa decisão. O repositório ainda não tem nenhum ADR.
evals.expected_output: Seeds doc/adr/ like `adr init` and writes the decision as 0002. Prose in Portuguese (the conversation language), scaffolding in canonical English. Context carries the stated forces, Consequences carries the stated downsides. Nothing invented.
assertions: Fresh log seeded like adr init: a 0001 seed ADR is created in doc/adr/ carrying the canonical adr-tools init content (the Nygard link and the adr-tools mention); its filename slug derives from its own title, which is translated when the log's prose language is not English
Decision ADR created as doc/adr/0002-<kebab-slug>.md (4-digit zero-padded filename, slug lowercased/hyphenated from the title)

Prose (H1 title text and the section bodies) is in Portuguese, matching the conversation, while the adr-tools scaffolding stays canonical English: the `Date:` label, the four `## Status` / `## Context` / `## Decision` / `## Consequences` headings in order, and the status word
H1 uses the un-padded number ('# 2. ...') and a 'Date: YYYY-MM-DD' line carries today's real date
Status section is 'Accepted'

Decision section is active voice ('We will ...' / 'Vamos ...') naming PostgreSQL; Context covers the stated forces: ACID transaction across order/stock/payment, team experience with Postgres, company already pays for RDS
Consequences include the stated downsides (more rigid schema, migrations become a deploy step), not only positives
No invented facts: no fabricated metrics, benchmarks, alternatives, or constraints beyond what the user stated

evals.name: vague-decision-asks
evals.prompt: escreve um adr ai dizendo que vamos trocar o redis
evals.expected_output: Asks targeted clarifying questions in Portuguese instead of delivering an ADR padded with invented context and consequences. The questions are the deliverable.
assertions: Does NOT deliver a finished ADR padded with invented context, replacement technology, or consequences
Final response asks targeted clarifying questions covering at least two of: what replaces Redis, why the change (forces), Redis's current role (cache/session/queue), accepted trade-offs
If any ADR file is created at all, it is explicitly a draft/skeleton with pending markers — not fabricated content presented as fact
Final response is in Portuguese, matching the user's conversation language

evals.name: supersede-existing-adr
evals.prompt: Esse repositório já tem ADRs em doc/adr. A gente decidiu abandonar a decisão do ADR 2 (sessões no Redis): vamos passar a usar tokens JWT stateless, porque o cluster Redis virou ponto único de falha nos deploys multi-região e o custo de manter ele replicado não compensa; com JWT a gente aceita o trade-off de não conseguir revogar sessão imediatamente (vamos usar expiração curta de 15 minutos). Escreve o novo ADR substituindo o antigo.
evals.expected_output: Writes doc/adr/0004-<slug>.md with a Supersedes link, and edits ONLY the Status section of 0002. The existing log is English, so the new ADR's prose is English too — consistency outranks the conversation language.
assertions: New ADR created as doc/adr/0004-<slug>.md — numbering continues from the highest existing (0003)

New ADR Status section reads exactly: 'Accepted', blank line, 'Supersedes [2. Store sessions in Redis](0002-store-sessions-in-redis.md)' — bracket text equals the target H1 minus '# ', href is the bare basename

Old 0002-store-sessions-in-redis.md edited so its Status section contains only 'Superseded by [4. <New title>](0004-<slug>.md)' (the 'Accepted' word removed); everything outside the Status section is byte-identical to the original
Modern spelling 'Superseded by'/'Supersedes' used, not the legacy 'Superceded'/'Supercedes'

New ADR prose is in English to match the existing log (consistency outranks the Portuguese conversation), four sections in order, ISO date, reflecting only stated facts: Redis as multi-region SPOF, replication cost, JWT with 15-minute expiry and no immediate revocation
ADRs 0001 and 0003 are untouched

evals.name: custom-dir-detection
evals.prompt: Documenta como ADR a decisão que tomamos hoje: a API pública vai ser versionada por URL (/v1, /v2) em vez de header de versão. Motivos: é o que nossos clientes de SDK já esperam, dá pra rotear por versão no gateway, e fica óbvio em logs e curl. O contra que anotamos: URLs proliferam e a gente vai ter que manter no máximo duas versões ativas ao mesmo tempo.
evals.expected_output: Reads .adr-dir and writes into docs/architecture/decisions/ as 0003. Prose matches the existing English log. Existing files untouched.
assertions: New ADR created inside docs/architecture/decisions/ (the directory named by .adr-dir) — NOT in doc/adr/ or docs/adr/
Numbered 0003 with a kebab-case slug; H1 reads '# 3. <Title>' (un-padded)
Prose is in English to match the existing log; the four sections appear in canonical order, 'Date:' is ISO 8601 with today's real date, Status is 'Accepted'
Context/Decision capture URL-path versioning over header versioning with the stated motives (SDK client expectations, gateway routing, visibility in logs/curl)
Consequences include URL proliferation and the cap of at most two active versions
Existing 0001, 0002 and the .adr-dir file are unmodified

evals.name: fresh-log-portuguese
evals.prompt: Documente esta decisão de arquitetura: decidimos adotar o RabbitMQ em vez do Kafka para a fila de mensagens entre os serviços. A equipe já tem experiência operacional com RabbitMQ, nosso volume é baixo (menos de 100 mensagens/segundo) e não precisamos de retenção de eventos. Aceitamos abrir mão do replay de eventos — se um dia precisarmos disso, será uma nova decisão.
evals.expected_output: Fresh doc/adr/ with a translated seed and the decision as 0002 — prose in Portuguese, scaffolding in canonical English. This eval exists to prove the split: translated title and body, untranslated headings, status word and Date label.
assertions: doc/adr/ is created with exactly two files: a 0001 seed ADR and a 0002 decision ADR
The 0001 seed ADR has its title and body translated into Portuguese and its filename slug derives from the translated title
The seed ADR keeps the adr-tools scaffolding in canonical English: the `Date:` label, the four `##` headings, and the status word are NOT translated
ADR 0002 has its H1 title text and the four section bodies in Portuguese
ADR 0002 keeps the scaffolding canonical: the `Date:` label, the four `## Status/Context/Decision/Consequences` headings in order, and the status word all in English
ADR 0002 keeps the exact structure: H1 with un-padded number, Date: line in ISO 8601 with today's real date, one blank line between every element
ADR 0002 filename follows NNNN-slug.md with the slug derived from the Portuguese title (lowercased, non-alphanumeric runs collapsed to single hyphens)
The Consequences section records the accepted trade-off (loss of event replay) and contains no invented facts beyond what the prompt established

evals.name: existing-english-log-pt-conversation
evals.prompt: Registre uma decisão: decidimos usar Redis para o cache de sessões dos usuários, em vez de guardar as sessões no PostgreSQL. O motivo é tirar carga de leitura do banco principal e ter expiração automática das chaves. O trade-off aceito é que agora temos mais um componente de infraestrutura para operar e as sessões são perdidas se o Redis reiniciar sem persistência.
evals.expected_output: Writes ADR 0003 in English because the existing log is English, and says so in Portuguese. Consistency outranks the conversation language.
assertions: A new ADR 0003 is created with its prose in ENGLISH even though the conversation is in Portuguese, because the existing log is in English — consistency outranks conversation language
The agent tells the user (in Portuguese) that it matched the existing log's language
The two existing ADR files (0001, 0002) are byte-for-byte untouched
ADR 0003 follows exact format: # 3. <title> H1, ISO 8601 date, four sections in order, Accepted status, blank-line discipline
The Consequences section includes the accepted trade-offs (extra infrastructure component, session loss on Redis restart)

evals.name: english-regression
evals.prompt: Write an ADR for this: we decided that all timestamps in our public API will use ISO 8601 strings in UTC instead of unix epoch integers. Reasons: epoch integers caused repeated timezone bugs in client integrations and are unreadable in logs. Trade-off we accepted: clients now have to parse strings, and payloads get slightly bigger.
evals.expected_output: English prompt, fresh repo: the canonical English seed verbatim plus the decision as 0002, entirely in English. Guards against over-translating.
assertions: doc/adr/ is created with the canonical English seed 0001-record-architecture-decisions.md verbatim (only the date substituted) and the decision as 0002
ADR 0002 is entirely in English with the four canonical section headings (Status, Context, Decision, Consequences) in order
ADR 0002 has Accepted status, ISO 8601 date with today's real date, H1 '# 2. <title>', and one-blank-line discipline
The Consequences section includes the accepted trade-offs (string parsing for clients, larger payloads), not just benefits
